workingCapitalIncrease.note: Trade lines only: 24,072 + 77,672 - 7,348 - 6,213 = 88,183 released. 'Other, net' (465,647) is excluded because it is the cash-flow offset of the litigation reversal, which is excluded from EBITDA (Joel 2026-10-09).

caveats: JUDGMENT, EBITDA: excludes the $418.6M non-cash litigation reversal (Joel 2026-10-09), so EBITDA is -$52.4M. Reported EBITDA including it is $366.2M. The matching 'Other, net' cash-flow line is excluded from working capital too.
